dataset_story: AMLSim is a multi-agent simulator designed to generate synthetic financial transactions for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) research, modeling both normal and laundering behaviors.
aura_purpose: Trains detection engines to identify complex laundering topologies and high-risk transaction chains.

citation.text: Suzumura & Kanezashi (2019). AMLSim: An Anti-Money Laundering Simulator.

step.description: Discrete time unit of the simulation

is_sar.description: Indicator of Suspicious Activity Report (SAR), marking laundering activity
